initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence."
              type: string
              example: "FRA-0007"
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "A stable shared identifier assigned when an owner joins an existing same-lastName household at the same address via sharesHousehold; every member shares one value."
              type: string
              example: "HH-1A2B3C4D"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'; two owners collide only when their whole keys match."
              type: string
              example: "+61400000001||"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'."
              type: string
              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate's fiscal year."
              type: string
              example: "SMI-0007-M26"
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Membership score: starts at 0, +2 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, +3 for tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone derived from the region/locality via the pinned table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); absent when the region is UNKNOWN."
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: "PHONE"
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "Derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when birthDate is not supplied."
              type: string
              example: "ADULT"
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when this owner shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode but has a different telephone (a soft, non-blocking duplicate); false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this one soft-matches on lastName and postcode, or absent when it is not a possible duplicate."
              type: integer
              format: int32
